Navigation Failure when Clicking on Android Native Search Button keyboard
descricao:
- Clicking on the search icon
- Clicking on the search field
- Typing a term
- Clicking on the magnifying glass icon on the Android Native Search Button from its keyboard
- App redirects to home instead of allowing navigation on search results
comportamento_ideal: After performing a search and clicking on the magnifying glass icon, the app should close the keyboard, perform the search, and allow navigation on the results without redirecting the user to the home screen
comportamento_atual: When performing a search in the application, instead of allowing navigation on the search results after clicking on the magnifying glass icon, the app redirects the user to the home screen
bdd:
Scenario: Navigating the search results
Given that the user has performed a search
 When the user clicks on the magnifying glass icon 
Then the keyboard should be closed and the search results should be displayed for navigation

titulo: [SUGGESTION] - Navigation Issue – Series header jumps to "You Might Like" section when reaching the last season item
descricao:
- Access any series.
- Navigate to the season selection header.
- press the right button on remote controll until reaching the last item.
- Press the right button key again.
comportamento_ideal: When reaching the last item of the season header, navigation should remain on the last element and not automatically switch to another section. It should follow the same navigation pattern applied to the first item.
comportamento_atual: When the last item of the season header is reached, navigation automatically jumps to the You Might Like section, causing unexpected behavior.
bdd:
Scenario: Navigation Issue on Series Season Selection Header
Given I am accessing a series
And navigate to the season selection header
And reach the last item of the header
When I press the right arrow key again
Then the navigation should remain on the last item of the header

descricao:
- Access the application.
- Go to the Home screen.
- Change the application language to Portuguese.
- Observe the titles of 'My List Movies' and 'My List Series' sections.
comportamento_ideal: When changing the language to Portuguese, the titles 'My List Movies' and 'My List Series' should respectively become 'Minha Lista de Filmes' and 'Minha Lista de Séries'. The translation should be done dynamically, without the need to reload the page.
comportamento_atual: When changing the language to Portuguese, the 'My List Movies' and 'My List Series' sections remain in English, while the other sections on the Home screen are correctly translated. The issue seems to be isolated in these two labels.
